shared_elements: standing human figures in profile facing one another
rows of script signs / hieroglyph-like inscription
figural scene placed in an upper register above text
justification: Both depict the same conventional scheme: an arched-topped panel whose upper zone holds a row of schematic profile standing figures facing/flanking a central element with small offering objects, and whose lower zone carries lines of pictographic script signs. The main difference is proportion of content: A devotes nearly the whole field to two figural registers with only scattered signs, while B reduces the figures to a narrow lunette strip above a very large block of continuous text, and B adds a winged/celestial emblem at the apex not present in A.
